name: Find readers who want to buy your book in LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram comments with an AI agent
description: Every evening, finds people who asked when the book comes out or said they would buy it, and saves them to a data table with the story they commented on.
shortDescription: Every evening, read the comments on your published posts and save readers who want the book to a data table.
keyFeatures: AI agent that reads comments with LinkedIn, Facebook Pages and Instagram Get Comments tools
Detects buying intent and remembers which story each reader commented on
Skips readers already saved, using a data table lookup tool
prerequisites: The content plan spreadsheet filled by the social media publisher template, with the post ID columns; replace REPLACE_WITH_CONTENT_PLAN_SPREADSHEET_ID
LinkedIn connection with the r_organization_social_feed scope enabled; LinkedIn only returns comments on company page posts, so remove the LinkedIn tool if you post from a personal profile
Instagram connection to a professional account
A ByteChef data table for interested readers; replace REPLACE_WITH_INTERESTED_READERS_TABLE
idealFor: Authors building a list of readers to contact on launch day.
steps: Read the published posts and their IDs from the content plan in Google Sheets.
The buying-intent agent reads the comments on each post from LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.
It looks each interested reader up in the data table and saves the new ones.
